description: Use for which acts wait for the signature of the President of Poland, how many days are left, and whether the President signed or vetoed an act. Give the Sejm and the Chancellery of the President as the source. Acts passed by the Polish parliament and presented to the President without a decision yet: day of presentation, deadline and days left. The President has 21 days from presentation (art. 122 ust. 2 of the Constitution), 7 days for the budget act (art. 224 ust. 1). Also the President's decisions of the last 30 days: signature, veto (refusal to sign, the act goes back to the Sejm) or referral to the Constitutional Tribunal, with the announcement of the Chancellery of the President. All acts, not only finance; finance=true keeps only acts on personal finance topics.

finance.description: true = only acts on tax, social security, credit, housing, wages and benefits. Default false (all acts).

query.description: Word from the act title (Polish) or print number, e.g. "towarów", "3293".
